scope: Independent correction review of all findings in rm302-independent-implementation-review.json
Source-to-import closed request/receipt field and wire-shape parity
Secret configuration marker and non-null text shape
Pinned OpenAPI supported subset and canonical project-root import resolution
Relevant positive, negative, audit and full supported-gate evidence

findings.result: The closed request and receipt record field sets and imported wire shapes are checked. The idempotency field must name ReminderIntentId directly; the valid fixture passes, while a mutation changing only that field to Uuid fails with SEM_SERVICE_CONTRACT_INVALID and emits no effect.
The referenced mail_api_key configuration field must be marked secret and resolve to a non-null string shape. The negative non-secret fixture reports SEM_SERVICE_SECRET_SINK_INVALID.

The pinned OpenAPI subset is parsed after digest validation, schema keywords outside the supported subset fail closed, and import resolution canonicalizes targets and rejects paths outside the inferred project root. The outside-root regression passes.

validation.independent: The reviewer independently repeated a valid temporary-project check and a mutation changing only ReminderMessage.idempotency_key from ReminderIntentId to Uuid; the valid project passed and the mutation failed with SEM_SERVICE_CONTRACT_INVALID. The focused nominal-identity unit test passed 1/1. The reviewer also confirmed the secret-marker and import-boundary correction evidence and made no edits.
validation.reportLimit: The supported verifier does not establish the still-open full golden application behavioural or other release gates. The correction review does not claim real-provider execution.

limitations: This approves RM-302's checked declaration/import/effect scope only; RM-303 real HTTP adapter conformance remains open.
Reviewer model, effort and duration were unavailable and are not inferred.
